parameters.content:
## Plan a short video batch
Run the sample as imported to get an Excel file. The three shots, including budgeted retakes, total $2.6136 against a $3 cap.

In **Enter shot list, rates and cap**, set your project, rates, cap, shots and maximum takes (including the first). An over-budget plan is flagged in the report. You can still reconcile existing charges. No step creates a render.

nodes.name: 2. Add receipts from your real renders

parameters.content:
## Reconcile existing paid takes
For each shot, replace the empty receipts array with entries such as `[{"taskId":"YOUR_EXISTING_ID","chargedUsd":null}]`. Copy the full ID as text. Fill chargedUsd only from the matching USD billing entry; enter 0 only for a verified zero charge. Each ID belongs to one take.

On **Read existing H3 receipt**, select an n8n Bearer Auth credential for the same Qianliu Hailuo-2 token used to create the task. MiniMax documents a seven-day query window. Run again later with the same IDs to refresh pending results. Requests run one at a time.

## Read the workbook
Open the last node, select **Binary** and download the XLSX. The project row compares the budget with the planned ceiling. Shot rows show the planned number of takes. Take rows compare an estimate from returned output seconds with your ledger charge. Unknown costs stay blank.

Rates in the example are dated 26 Nov 2026, from [Qianliu H3 pricing](https://www.plusapi.cn/pricing?keyword=MiniMax-H3), operated by the author. Replace them with your rates. Estimates cover text-only H3 generation; reference media, other tasks and unverified usage require separate review.
